newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.07 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.07 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.07 percent to close at 1.0486 per greenback on dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $54 million. Last Friday, net dollar flows posted an $83.1 million surplus.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real rose 0.04 percent to end at 1.0543, traders said.
In the illegal parallel market, it fell 0.46 percent to close at 1.082.
